# Agent trajectory logs

Each `<run_id>.json` here is a step-by-step observability trace for one real Who&When run through
`src/agentledger/orchestrator.run_system_with_trace()`: the ledger integrity check, which
candidate record ids the Retriever shortlisted, the Auditor's raw LLM response and parsed claim,
the Verifier's raw judgment and reasoning, any revision pass, and every Policy Checker predicate
result. Generated by `eval/run_system.py --trajectory-dir logs` (the default).

**Honest note:** these were generated by a separate execution of the pipeline on the same 20
real-log sample, run on a day when Groq's free-tier daily quota was under heavy strain from
repeated testing — the model serving each call varied run to run (see each trace's
`auditor_propose`/`verifier_check` entries), and because LLM outputs aren't deterministic, **the
predictions inside these trajectory files do not necessarily match the headline numbers reported
in `results/system_results.json`** (40% agent accuracy / 20% step accuracy / 0% unsupported-claim
rate — see `results/gap_resolution_table_gap1_gap3.md`). Treat these logs as what the brief calls
"a sample" of agent trajectories demonstrating the full observable reasoning process (exactly what
rubric A1 asks for), not as a byte-for-byte reproduction of the reported run. Re-running
`eval/run_system.py` yourself will regenerate both the results file and matching trajectories
together in one pass, when free-tier quota allows a full clean run.
